name: list_union_map_arm_rejects_null_stays_fallback
description: FALLBACK-BOUNDARY GUARD (family: union_null_composite_arm) — and the live DISCRIMINATOR for the map arm's null behaviour. list<string | map<string,int>> over [null] puts the same union at a position where NO class default_value can rescue it. BAML emits [] — the element is SKIPPED via ArrayItemParseError — which happens only if the union genuinely ERRORED, i.e. the MAP arm did NOT absorb the null into {}. (Contrast union_null_composite_arm_stays_fallback, where a LIST arm survives and the element is kept as [].) Native declines: coerceListChild cannot PROVE a failing UNION element is a BAML parse error rather than a deferred success (provenListItemError has no union entry), so it falls back rather than skip an item BAML might keep. want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
